title: Visual crowding
learner: Sara plays comfortably up to 80 bpm and reads notes from C4 to F5. She has mastered quarter notes, half notes and pairs of eighth notes.

needs.description: Dense notation blurs together: the staff must be enlarged at least 1.8 times and groups of sixteenth notes are avoided.

intent: The teacher asks for an 8-bar exercise in F major, 3/4, at 76 bpm, with pairs of eighth notes and a medium rhythmic complexity.
expectation: The staff is enlarged and no pair of sixteenth notes appears, even though the teacher asks for some rhythmic variety. Eighth notes are a preference here, because Sara already masters them.
